From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@horizon.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Promo bundling request for Horizon Accelerator cohort

Hi Connor,

Hope you're well — thanks again for the platform walkthrough last week. We're finalizing benefits for our upcoming Horizon Accelerator cohort and would like to bundle Redwood's startup credit (the usual cohort grant) with an additional sandbox credit pool for demo day workloads.

We have 12 teams; typical ask is: 100k tokens cohort credit + 50k sandbox tokens for the demo period (48–72 hours each). Our legal/parter team also asked whether this could be a single invoice line item and whether any promotional credits can be extended to cover ephemeral demo infra.

Is there any flexibility for a one-off promo braiding / credit consolidation? If useful, I can share our MA plan and cohort schedule (I attached a summary). Also, timeline is tight — we need clarity on billing/DocuSign by next Wednesday so we can include it in our sponsor pack.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ramos
Program Lead, Horizon Labs
sofia@horizon.ai

Attachment: horizon_cohort_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@horizon.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo bundling request for Horizon Accelerator cohort

Sofia — really appreciate the detail and the sample numbers. Forwarding to Ben (pricing lead) and Mina (billing/ops) to scope a path that meets your timeline.

Quick answers up front:
- We can consolidate credits onto a single invoice line for accounting, but it requires a short contracting addendum (one paragraph) so our finance team can route it as a promotional line item.
- Promo "braiding" (combining a cohort grant and a short-duration sandbox pool) is possible as a time-boxed credit bucket — we'd mark the sandbox credits as "demo allotment" with an expiration window.
- We can offer a one-time promotional uplift (approx +15% to total token allowance) as a cohort sweetener depending on commitment to a follow-on pilot or paid plan.

Ben / Mina — attaching Horizon's cohort summary Sofia shared. Can you suggest a packaging/template and a one-off promo that stays within our approval thresholds? If yes, I'll send Sofia a short SOW + DocuSign link.

Connor O'Brien
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.inference

Attachment: Horizon_MA_plan.xlsx (attachment stub)

Connor / Mina — thanks for the heads-up and the deck. Thought bubbles:

1) Packaging: offer a "Cohort+Demo" bundle: 100k cohort credit (standard) + 60k demo pool (time-boxed to demo week) + 1 month of reduced per-token rates on stored embeddings for teams that commit to a pilot within 60 days.
2) Promo uplift: one-time +15% on the combined pool (so 184k tokens total) conditional on a signed pilot MOU for at least one team (not binding for Horizon overall). That keeps us inside commercial guardrails while giving a nice sweetener.
3) Billing: Mina can consolidate to a single invoice line but needs a short SOW paragraph with the expiration dates and a purchase order reference from Horizon.

Mina — can you confirm internal ops cadence (how fast we can get a DocuSign + invoice out) and whether Finance will accept the promo as "marketing credit" or if it needs revenue recognition as a discount?

Ben

Ben / Connor — Ops can turn a DocuSign + invoice in 24 hours once we have: (a) the consolidated SOW paragraph, (b) a PO number or billing contact, and (c) explicit expiration windows for the demo pool. Finance prefers to route these as contra-revenue (discount) rather than marketing credits for compliance, but that doesn't change customer-facing wording.

I recommend this SOW snippet for inclusion in the DocuSign: 
"Redwood Inference will provide Horizon Labs a time-boxed Cohort+Demo credit bundle of 184,000 token-equivalents (100,000 cohort + 60,000 demo pool + 15% promotional uplift). The demo pool will be valid for 14 days centered on the scheduled Demo Week (dates to be provided by Horizon). Credits not consumed by expiration will be forfeited. Redwood will consolidate the grant to a single invoice line referencing the Horizon PO #."

If you want, I can draft the DocuSign envelope and route it to Horizon Billing once Connor confirms the PO and dates.
